cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

mechanism: A directs a subordinate proxy to challenge an absent higher authority while approving personal support only from a less exposed position.
confusable: D08 gets someone to break a rule; D56 specifically recruits a challenge to authority before A risks doing so.
comparison: An overtime inquiry uses physical support positioning, unlike the club alternative delaying a signature until the challenge is validated.
seedUse: The existing D56-a question deferral and restricted beside-me request already let S01 authority control who takes the initial risk.
